all.eq: Greater than 50% but not "all or substantially all"

questions.text: How many of the 14 agreements satisfy ALL of the following: `dp_so_stock_threshold` = «Greater than 50% but not "all or substantially all"» AND `dp_so_fpov_sole` = «No»? Answer with an integer.
How many of the 14 agreements satisfy ALL of the following: `dp_noshop_rep_liability` = «Yes» AND `dp_tail_still_pending` = «Yes»? Answer with an integer.
How many of the 14 agreements satisfy ALL of the following: `dp_cor_match_initial` = «4 business days» AND NOT (`dp_ftr_limitations` includes «Any breach of no-shop»)? Answer with an integer.

List every agreement that satisfies: `dp_ftr_match_initial` = «5 business days» AND NOT (`dp_ftr_match_additional` = «2 business days or less»). If no agreement qualifies, answer with an empty list [].
List every agreement that satisfies: `dp_so_fpov_sole` = «No» AND `dp_tail_public_yn` = «No». If no agreement qualifies, answer with an empty list [].

List every agreement that satisfies: `dp_cor_match_additional` = «2 business days or less» AND `dp_cor_so_standard` = «"Inconsistent" with fiduciary duties». If no agreement qualifies, answer with an empty list [].
List every agreement that satisfies: `dp_so_asset_threshold` = «50%» AND `dp_tail_still_pending` = «No». If no agreement qualifies, answer with an empty list [].
List every agreement that satisfies: NOT (`dp_so_stock_threshold` gives the same answer as `dp_so_asset_threshold`). If no agreement qualifies, answer with an empty list [].
Which agreement(s) have the highest value of the number of options selected for `dp_ftr_limitations` (not counting 'No')? List all tied agreements.
For `gen_consideration`, list every agreement whose answer is shared by at most 3 of the 14 agreements (counting the agreement itself).
For `gen_consideration`, list every agreement whose answer is shared by at most 1 of the 14 agreements (counting the agreement itself).

Consider the deal points `dp_cor_match_initial`, `dp_cor_match_additional`, `dp_ftr_match_initial`, `dp_ftr_match_additional`, `dp_ftr_limitations`, `dp_so_stock_threshold`, `dp_so_asset_threshold`, `dp_so_fpov_sole`, `dp_cor_so_standard`, `dp_noshop_rep_liability`, `dp_tail_length`, `dp_tail_still_pending`, `dp_tail_public_yn`, `gen_consideration`. For each of them, take the most common answer across the 14 agreements (complete answer; for each listed deal point the most common answer is unique). List every agreement whose answer differs from that most common answer on at least 9 of these deal points.

Considering only `dp_cor_match_initial`, `dp_ftr_match_additional`, `dp_fidout_trigger`: group together agreements whose answers are identical on every one of these deal points. Report every group with two or more agreements, as a list of lists of agreement ids (agreements with a unique combination are omitted).
Considering only `dp_cor_match_additional`, `dp_fidout_trigger`, `dp_tail_still_pending`: how many distinct answer combinations occur among the 14 agreements? Answer with an integer.

Which other agreement(s) give the same answer as A04 on the largest number of the 15 deal points in the questionnaire? (A multi-select answer counts as the same only if the full set matches.) List all tied agreements.
